data.name: Durratul
data.gender_notes: Durratul is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Durratul refers to a precious pearl or gemstone, symbolizing purity, beauty, and great value. The name is derived from the Arabic word 'durrat' which means 'pearl' or 'jewel'. The pearl is a metaphor for the purity and worth of a believer's soul and actions. The name Durratul carries the meaning “Pearl, precious stone” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Durratul usually hope their child will grow to embody pearl, precious stone and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A precious gem, reflecting the inner radiance of faith and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Durratul belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pearl, precious stone.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Durratul total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: دُرَّةً
in_arabic.long_meaning: دُرَّةً هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، ويعني اللؤلؤة الثمينة والجميلة جدا للغاية، وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سورة النور الآية 31، حيث قال تعالى: 'وَمَثَلُ كَلِمَةٍ خَبيثَةٍ كَشَجَرَةٍ خَبيثَةٍ لَا يَأْتِيهَا مِن فَوقِهَا إِلَّا رَشَفاتٌ حَتّى إِذَا أَصبَحَت خَليطاً ذَهَبت بِها الرِيحُ وَكُنتُ أَقولُ لَم تَذهَب بِها الرِيحُ وَكَذَلكَ الكَلِمُ الطَيِّبَةُ تَصعَدُ إِلَى السَّماءِ ثُمَّ يَأخُذُها رَبٌّي عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فَيَبعَثُها بِها مَلَكاً إِلَى الأَرضِ ثُمَّ يَأخُذُها مَلكُ المَوتِ ثُمَّ يُلقِيها مِثلَ اللُّؤلُؤَةِ بَينَ يَدَيهِ ثُمَّ يَقولُ أَنَا الَّذي أَذهَبُ بِالسَّيِّئاتِ وَأَنَا الَّذي أَجعَلُ الخَيراتِ وَأَنَا الَّذي أَمُتُ وَأَنَا الَّذي أُحيي وَأَنَا عَلى كُلِّ شَيءٍ قَدييرٌ'
